dedupe_keys.name: ribuild survey of historic building stock with renovation case studies

description: This database gives background on the historic building stock in the RIBuild project partner countries, with case studies of renovations that added internal insulation to historic buildings. It was deposited on Zenodo on 16 May 2020 by M. Morelli of Aalborg University, A. Blumberga, I. Veidenbergs, D. Blumberga and A. Grāvelsiņš of Riga Technical University, and C. Conrad, A. Sönchen and P. Freudenberg of TU Dresden, as background for RIBuild Deliverable D1.1. The Excel database covers historic stock energy consumption, stock description, construction elements and case studies; case study sheets give floor area, use, envelope thickness and materials, renovation history, energy use before and after, renovation cost, typical defects, drivers, tools used and user satisfaction. Coverage: case studies in Denmark, Germany, Switzerland, Belgium and Sweden. Access: twelve spreadsheets on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: case study sheets are filled only where information was available. Simulation uses: retrofit planning, moisture-safe internal insulation and cost benchmarks for historic buildings. Related records: the listed buildings records and the URBAN PERiSCOPE pilot building.
